Entrepreneurs

Business Leaders

Senior executives and promoters managing concentrated equity, deferred compensation and complex wealth structures alongside demanding careers.

Frequently Asked

Questions worth asking early.

Who do you work with?

I work with HNIs, entrepreneurs, business leaders and senior corporate professionals looking for structured, long-term guidance on wealth, tax and investments.

What areas of financial planning do you focus on?

Financial planning, advisory, analysis, wealth management, retirement planning, insurance, personal tax planning and tax preparation — aligned with your broader goals.

How can I schedule a consultation?

You can request a consultation through the booking page. Select your preferred date and time, share a brief on your situation, and I will confirm the slot.

Do you work with business owners?

Yes. I regularly work with entrepreneurs and promoters on personal wealth alongside their business interests, including liquidity events and tax structure.

Can consultations be conducted online?

Yes. Consultations can be conducted over video call, making it convenient regardless of where you are located.

Are you SEBI-registered?

I work in a wealth management and advisory capacity at Nuvama Wealth. Specific registration details can be discussed during a consultation.
